identity.decision: Millcreek must use the verified Salt Lake Valley service-area profile. The four pending-evidence pages retain the current business keystone until current service-area evidence establishes whether a Salt Lake Valley override applies; the keystone must not be described as a city-specific GBP.

blockedClaimClasses.replacement: Explain that price depends on measured roof area, access, pitch, assembly, material, and discovered conditions; invite a written scope without publishing an unsupported range.
Offer phone and scheduling options without promising 24/7 coverage, exact travel time, or a universal response window.
Direct the homeowner to the municipality for current requirements and state that permit responsibility must be confirmed in the written project scope.
Retain the verified Utah DOPL license and BBB accreditation only. Do not publish general-liability or workers-compensation assertions until current evidence is registered.
State that timing is confirmed after roof assembly, scope, access, weather, material availability, and permit requirements are known.
Describe observable conditions and link to primary weather or municipal sources; do not quantify citywide frequency or years of life lost without registered evidence.
Use non-project neighborhood and jurisdiction context. A review or image may be attributed to a city only when the private project record or public review itself establishes that city.

provisionalClaims.decision: Do not expand the claim or add it to the verified registry. Preserve it during this correction unless the owner supplies a conflicting current instrument.

requiredChecks: production build-gate receipt after authorized release
releaseGate.decisionRule: Keep only if integrity stays green and the fixed weekly organic, exact-CID Maps, Google AIO, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini readings improve or hold without a material regression.
